overview.description: The Invesco DB US Dollar Index Bearish Fund (UDN) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long g10 basket, short usd currency. The fund tracks the changes in value of the euro, Swiss franc, Japanese yen, British pound, Swedish krona and Canadian dollar relative to the US dollar, via USDX contracts. UDN was launched on Feb 20, 2007 and is issued by Invesco.
